docs.title: B2B Infra thesis · 2026 update
docs.snippet: Three patterns we want to back this year: (1) inference distribution at the edge, (2) developer-led GTM, (3) memory layer for agents. Pass on commodity wrappers.

docs.title: Founder profile checklist
docs.snippet: What we look for: (a) 4+ years shipping in the space, (b) public OSS or product evidence, (c) co-founder relationship pre-existing the company.
